WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.TITLE: WhatsApp Connection
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.DESCRIPTION: Connect your WhatsApp account by scanning a QR code or using a pairing code. Each connection creates a dedicated inbox that works alongside your other channels.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.NOT_CONFIGURED_HELP: Set the WHATSAPP_BRIDGE_URL and WHATSAPP_BRIDGE_API_KEY environment variables pointing to your WhatsApp API service.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.EMPTY: No WhatsApp connections yet. Create one above to get started.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.CREATE_SUCCESS: WhatsApp instance created. Click Connect to scan the QR code.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.CREATE_ERROR: Failed to create instance. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.RELINK_SUCCESS: Inbox created and linked to the instance.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.RELINK_ERROR: Failed to create inbox. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.CONNECT_ERROR: Failed to connect. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.LOGOUT_ERROR: Failed to disconnect. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_CONNECTION.DELETE_ERROR: Failed to delete instance. Please try again.

ORPHANED.TITLE: Orphaned Inboxes
ORPHANED.DESCRIPTION: These inboxes were created but their bridge connection no longer exists. They can be safely deleted.

QR.TITLE: Link Your WhatsApp
QR.INSTRUCTIONS: Open WhatsApp on your phone → Settings → Linked Devices → Link a Device → Scan this QR code or enter the pairing code

HANDOFF.TITLE: Handoff
HANDOFF.RESUME_KEYWORDS_HELP: Comma-separated keywords that resume bot interaction after human handoff
HANDOFF.RESUME_MESSAGE_HELP: Message sent when bot resumes after handoff
HANDOFF.RESUME_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Bot is back! How can I help?
HANDOFF.ACTIVE_CHATS_HELP: Chats where the bot is paused and a human is handling the conversation. Toggle to resume bot.

LINKED_INBOX.TITLE: Linked Inbox
LINKED_INBOX.DESCRIPTION: This instance is connected to a Chatwoot inbox that handles messages from this WhatsApp number.
LINKED_INBOX.NAME: Inbox Name

WEBHOOKS.TITLE: Webhooks
WEBHOOKS.DESCRIPTION: Configure a custom webhook URL to receive all incoming WhatsApp messages alongside Chatwoot. Use this to connect external automation tools like Typebot, n8n, Make.com, or your own API.
WEBHOOKS.CUSTOM_URL_HELP: When set, incoming WhatsApp messages will also be forwarded to this URL in addition to Chatwoot.
